items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: He did actually play in the band for a minute. He didn’t last long.

ctx.x: Okay. You’d find a way to —

We’d find a way to — we’d get up early, have some coffee and go right to the club and, you know the lights would be off and the club would be shut down and we’d come in through the kitchen and we’d play. Whether it was with organ and drums or electric piano and a set of bongos, or whatever it was, or two keyboards, or anything. We made music every day. Maybe that was the single most inspiring time of my life, or inspired maybe I should say — with Don. And of course then Jaco [Pastorius] was on the scene then,…
He probably — did he have trouble fitting into being a bass player in the Lou Rawls band? What it took?
